Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention

High throughput serving of large language models (LLMs) requires batching sufficiently many requests at a time. However, existing systems struggle because the key-value cache (KV cache) memory for each request is huge and grows and shrinks dynamically. WavTTS: Towards High-Quality Zero-Shot TTS via Direct Raw Waveform Modeling

Recently, diffusion models operating on VAE latents or mel-spectrograms have become the dominant paradigm for zero-shot TTS.
